title: LADM LA_Point
description: A surveyed boundary point or building corner that has been officially registered in the cadastre. LA_Point extends LA_Feature — the 'place' geometry must be a Point in the survey CRS (e.g. HTRS96/TM). Only final adjusted coordinates are stored here; raw measurements and auxiliary points remain in the LA_SpatialSource assets.

featureType.description: Discriminator identifying this as a registered cadastral point

type.description: LA_Point geometry must be a single Point

pointType.description: LA_PointType codelist. Common values: boundary (parcel corner), building (building corner), road (road centreline point).

monumentation.description: Type of physical boundary monument (e.g. concreteMonument, ironPeg, naturalObject, unmarked).

state.description: LA_PointStatusType — registration state of this point (e.g. set, found, replaced, removed).

spatialSource.description: Reference to the LA_SpatialSource (survey) that established this point

lifespanVersion.description: System/database lifespan of this point version
